scope: AWS Open Data High Court metadata records; bench=testcase excluded

upstreamUnique.deduplication: one identity per court across both metadata variants and all rows
upstreamUnique.denominator: count of distinct upstream object identities; distinct non-blank CNR is reported separately and is never the accounting denominator

courtMonth.decisionMonth: earliest normalized YYYY-MM assigned to the same upstream object by any metadata row; null and unparsed remain explicit buckets
courtMonth.conflicts: count every object assigned more than one month before choosing the earliest

freshnessSummary.scope: top-level freshness summary completeness and source-unavailable count use the newest 12 decisionMonth buckets; all-time values remain separately nested

statePrecedence: TEXT_READABLE: a canonical judgments row exists for source_url
IMAGE_ONLY_OCR_PENDING: official_source_artifact holds raw_bytes or storage_key for the source_url and text_state=IMAGE_ONLY_OCR_PENDING
SOURCE_ARTIFACT_HELD: official_source_artifact holds raw_bytes or storage_key for the source_url
POLICY_REFUSED: latest official-source evidence explicitly records a policy refusal
SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE_CURRENT: direct source evidence records absence and lastCheckedAt remains inside the revalidation window
ACTIONABLE_FAILURE: every other attempted non-held object
NEVER_ATTEMPTED: no held row, artifact evidence, refusal, source-unavailable evidence, or failure-ledger row

sourceUnavailableCurrent.changedObjectRule: recheck a source-unavailable object when its owning upstream metadata partition is NEW, GROWN, SHRUNK, or CHANGED
sourceUnavailableCurrent.expiryRule: after 90 days the row is due for bounded revalidation and cannot be permanently blacklisted
